18 Years of Kotha Bangaru Lokam ❤️

The film that marked my first step into the Telugu Film Industry!

18 years ago, Kotha Bangaru Lokam became a special part of my life, not because of how much screen time I had, but because of the doors it opened for me.

I was just a small part of this beautiful film, but looking back, I realize how big a role it played in my journey.

This film taught me something I’ve carried with me ever since, it’s not always about how much screen time you get, but about the people you meet, the connections you build, and the opportunities that follow.

It was through this film that I discovered my love for cinema even more deeply, built some wonderful connections, and eventually got the opportunity to play one of the main characters in Aa Okkadu.

What started as a small appearance slowly turned into a passion that made me explore different sides of filmmaking from acting to writing, direction, and production.

18 years later, my love for cinema has only grown stronger. There is still so much to learn, so much to achieve, and so many stories I want to tell.

Some films entertain us. Some films inspire us. And a few films become a part of our own story. Kotha Bangaru Lokam will always be one of those films for me. ❤️

Forever grateful for where it all began!

@SVC_official

The unemployment rate rose to 6.5%, while both full-time and part-time employment declined.

The services sector lost 52,300 jobs, with labor force participation falling to 64.8%.

Meanwhile, annual wage growth accelerated to 2.3%, complicating the inflation outlook.
